ticketComments.content: Hi Rahul, I have received your incident ticket and inspected the crash logs. Could you run `sudo dmesg | grep -i panic` and paste the trace here?
[INTERNAL TECH NOTE] Hardware Apple Diagnostics run showed error code VFD001 (display adapter / RAM memory page fault). May need motherboard exchange under AppleCare+ warranty.
Thanks Marcus! I generated the dmesg trace and confirmed it happened right after starting the Docker daemon. Looking forward to your guidance.
